complexity.notes: Correctness is fragile: any input string containing the delimiter emoji breaks decoding, and encode([]) and encode(['']) both rely on subtle edge-case behavior of split/pop; a length-prefixed encoding (e.g., 'len#string') is the standard robust approach. Also missing 'from typing import List' import.
complexity.summary: Joins the strings with an emoji delimiter (plus a trailing delimiter) for encoding, and splits on the same delimiter for decoding, dropping the trailing empty piece. L is the total number of characters across all strings.
